from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    lines = set()
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                for k in range(abs(dr)+1):
                    out[r1+sr*k][c1+sc*k] = 1
                # Record a diagonal segment; 6 markers on it define crossing diagonals.
                lines.add((r1-c1, sr == sc, min(r1,r2), max(r1,r2), min(c1,c2), max(c1,c2)))
    for r, c in sixes:
        on_line = any((r-c == diff if same else r+c == diff) and minr <= r <= maxr and minc <= c <= maxc
                      for diff, same, minr, maxr, minc, maxc in lines)
        if on_line:
            # Draw the opposite diagonal through the 6 marker to both grid edges.
            for rr in range(h):
                cc = r + c - rr
                if 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc] = 6
    return out
'''
f=base/'task-5f2b70e4.py'
f.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(f),'exec'),globals())
grid=[[4]*16 for _ in range(19)]
for r,c,v in [(2,2,1),(4,4,6),(4,14,1),(6,6,6),(7,14,6),(10,10,1),(15,2,6),(17,9,1)]: grid[r][c]=v
ans=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in ans))
